title: Knights Within
description:
Knights Within is being developed by Indecision Labs, a solo developer working on their first public project.

Humanity is fighting for survival against the wraiths that now reign dominant in the world. Thankfully, technology is on our side. Fight your way through hordes of enemies while completing objectives to further mankind's struggle to survive. 
 

Embark on procedurally generated missions to push back the threat of the Wraiths. Progressing through a mission grants randomized modifiers for both you and your enemies. The longer you survive, the crazier the powers get, keeping each run fresh and unique.
 

Create your own class by equipping gear mods for your various weapons and armor to enhance your preferred playstyle. As one of the prestigious knights protecting humanity, you have access to the most technologically advanced equipment available. 

Run missions by yourself, or bring up to 3 friends to fight alongside you against the never ending hordes of enemies in your way.

Play the default mission based mode, completing objectives while struggling to survive. Or try the Gauntlet mode, where your stage progress is saved and the difficulty scales endlessly.

 

Features• 1-4 players (up to 8 supported unofficially)

• Procedurally generated maps and objectives

• Free-form combat: maintain control of your movement while always having access to your sword and firearm

• Loadouts: Equip weapons, add mods to them and choose paths to create your own class

• In-run progression: rogue-lite style upgrades for both you and your enemies 

• Meta-progression: Unlock and upgrade gear between missions

• 3 game-modes: Multi-Act primary mode, a smaller standard mission mode and an endless difficulty climber
description_short: Knights Within is a hack&slash horde shooter with roguelite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Either solo or with friends, can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?
